_comment: Copy this file to local_paths.json (git-ignored) next to it, or to ~/.config/boutscope/local_paths.json for an installed package, and fill in the paths for each machine. BOUTSCOPE_<KEY> environment variables override any value; BOUTSCOPE_PROFILE picks the profile. See src/boutscope/config.py.

local.video_root: <absolute path to the folder your project's video paths are relative to>
local.project_root: <absolute path to the folder that holds your boutscope projects>

hpc.video_root: <cluster path to the video folder, e.g. /projects/<group>/videos>
